title: Lattis
description: Search indexed websites, read raw page markdown, and score AI visibility for any site.
summary: Search indexed websites, read raw page markdown, and score AI visibility for any site.
offersHint: Search indexed websites, read raw page markdown, and score AI visibility for any site. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.lattis.dev/mcp · Packages: npm:@lattis-dev/cli

toolsPreview.name: sitedex_search
toolsPreview.description: Search every indexed website. Returns ranked markdown passages with the source URL, heading path, and a relevance score. Pass `site` to scope to one domain.

toolsPreview.name: sitedex_list_sites
toolsPreview.description: Every website Sitedex has indexed, with name, category, page count, and AI Visibility Score. Use it to discover what is available before searching.

toolsPreview.name: sitedex_get_site
toolsPreview.description: Site profile and headline AI Visibility Score for one domain — name, description, category, page count, the buyer questions the site answers, and which AI-readable artifacts (`llms.txt`, MCP card, WebMCP manifest, JSON-LD) the owner has installed.

toolsPreview.name: sitedex_list_pages
toolsPreview.description: Paths Sitedex has indexed on a domain — title, URL, path. Use it to browse a site's structure before searching or fetching.

toolsPreview.name: sitedex_get_page
toolsPreview.description: The full markdown of one page on an indexed site. Use it after `search` points you at a URL and you want the whole page.
